title: McGraw Hill CEO Philip Moyer on AI’s Impact in Education
description: Philip Moyer, CEO of McGraw Hill, spoke about the evolving role of AI in education during the back-to-school period. He emphasized that McGraw Hill, a longstanding education company, now serves both traditional and digital learning needs globally, with around 100 million curriculum licenses and 7.5 million AI tools in use. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Former E*Trade CEO on Private Markets, Rise of AI
description: Mitch Caplan, former CEO of E*Trade Financial and current head of Willow Wealth, joined the program to discuss recent market fluctuations and their impact on retail investors. He provided insights into how individual investors tend to react during periods of market uncertainty and volatility. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Northrop CEO Expects ‘Decent Share’ of Golden Dome Contracts
description: Northrop Grumman Corp. Chief Executive Officer Kathy Warden said the Trump administration’s Golden Dome space defense system was becoming “very tangible” for defense contractors and that her company will end up with a “decent share” of a program that may eventually cost more than $1 trillion.
